package fixture

type Box struct{ a, b, c, d bool }

type Worker struct{}

func f() {}

// CycPos has nine ifs: cyclomatic 1 + 9 = 10.
func CycPos(x *Box) {
	if x.a { f() }
	if x.b { f() }
	if x.c { f() }
	if x.d { f() }
	if x.a { f() }
	if x.b { f() }
	if x.c { f() }
	if x.d { f() }
	if x.a { f() }
}

// CycNeg has eight ifs: cyclomatic 9.
func CycNeg(x *Box) {
	if x.a { f() }
	if x.b { f() }
	if x.c { f() }
	if x.d { f() }
	if x.a { f() }
	if x.b { f() }
	if x.c { f() }
	if x.d { f() }
}

// NestPos nests four ifs: depth 4, one bump, cyclomatic 5.
func NestPos(x *Box) {
	if x.a {
		if x.b {
			if x.c {
				if x.d {
					f()
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// NestNeg nests three ifs: depth 3, one bump, cyclomatic 4.
func NestNeg(x *Box) {
	if x.a {
		if x.b {
			if x.c {
				f()
			}
		}
	}
}

// BumpsPos has two separate top-level blocks that reach depth 2.
func BumpsPos(x *Box) {
	if x.a {
		if x.b {
			f()
		}
	}
	f()
	if x.c {
		if x.d {
			f()
		}
	}
}

// BumpsNeg has one nested block and one flat if.
func BumpsNeg(x *Box) {
	if x.a {
		if x.b {
			f()
		}
	}
	if x.c {
		f()
	}
}

// BoolPos has three boolean operators in one condition.
func BoolPos(x *Box) {
	if x.a && x.b && x.c || x.d {
		f()
	}
}

// BoolNeg has two boolean operators in one condition.
func BoolNeg(x *Box) {
	if x.a && x.b || x.c {
		f()
	}
}

// BoolSplit has two conditions with two operators each: the maximum is 2, and
// the parentheses of the second one do not split it.
func BoolSplit(x *Box) {
	if x.a && x.b || x.c {
		f()
	}
	if (x.a || x.b) && x.c {
		f()
	}
}

// ArgsPos has five parameters (a, b, c, d, e share one declaration).
func ArgsPos(a, b, c, d, e *Box) {}

// ArgsNeg has four parameters.
func ArgsNeg(a, b, c, d *Box) {}

// PrimPos has four parameters, three of them primitive (75%).
func PrimPos(a string, b int, c bool, d *Box) {}

// PrimNeg has four parameters, two of them primitive (50%).
func PrimNeg(a string, b int, c *Box, d *Box) {}

// PrimFew has three primitive parameters: too few for the smell.
func PrimFew(a string, b int, c bool) {}

// Variadic counts the variadic parameter once.
func Variadic(a *Box, rest ...string) {}

// Constructs uses every Go decision point once; default is not one.
func Constructs(a int, v any, ch chan int, xs []int) int {
	if a > 0 && a < 10 || a == 20 {
		a++
	} else if a < 0 {
		a--
	}
	for i := 0; i < a; i++ {
	}
	for range xs {
	}
	switch a {
	case 1, 2:
	case 3:
	default:
	}
	switch v.(type) {
	case int:
	case string:
	default:
	}
	select {
	case <-ch:
	default:
	}
	return a
}

// ElseIf is a chain on one level.
func ElseIf(x *Box) {
	if x.a {
		f()
	} else if x.b {
		f()
	} else if x.c {
		f()
	} else {
		f()
	}
}

func (w *Worker) Method(x *Box) {
	if x.a {
		f()
	}
}

// Closures: the go func and defer func are anonymous and count toward the
// function; run is a named closure and a unit of its own.
func Closures(x *Box) {
	run := func() {
		if x.a {
			f()
		}
	}
	go func() {
		if x.b {
			f()
		}
	}()
	defer func() {
		for x.c {
			f()
		}
	}()
	run()
}
